useWhen: You want to ensure your product is accessible to all users
You're preparing for legal compliance (ADA, WCAG)
You want to expand your potential user base

workflow.description: Document problems by WCAG success criteria
Rank issues by impact and effort
Build timeline for addressing all issues

examples.input: A SaaS dashboard for project management with features like task lists, team chat, file uploads, and calendar views
examples.output:
## Accessibility Review: Project Management Dashboard

### Compliance Status
- **WCAG 2.1 Level AA:** Partial
- **ADA Compliance:** Needs work
- **Screen Reader:** Needs testing

---

### Critical Issues (Fix Now)

| Issue | Location | WCAG | Fix |
|-------|----------|-----|-----|
| Missing alt text | Task cards | 1.1.1 | Add descriptive alt |
| No keyboard nav | Calendar view | 2.1.1 | Add tab index |
| Low contrast | Chat messages | 1.4.3 | Increase to 4.5:1 |
| No skip links | All pages | 2.4.1 | Add skip to main |

---

### Major Issues (Fix Soon)

| Issue | Location | WCAG | Fix |
|-------|----------|-----|-----|
| Missing form labels | Task creation | 1.3.1 | Add aria-label |
| Focus not visible | Buttons | 2.4.7 | Add outline |
| No error announcements | Upload | 4.1.3 | Add aria-live |

---

### Minor Issues (Nice to Have)

- Add high contrast mode toggle
- Support reduced motion preferences
- Add text size controls

---

### Quick Wins (< 1 day)
1. Add `alt` to all images
2. Add `aria-label` to icon buttons
3. Increase button contrast
4. Add focus states

### Estimated Effort
- Quick Wins: 1 day
- Critical: 1 week
- Full WCAG AA: 2-3 weeks

### Tools to Use
- axe DevTools
- WAVE
- NVDA (screen reader)
